question: Indicate which of the following is a mitochondrial disease:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Leigh syndrome" -> "associated with mitochondrial dysfunction" -> "characterized by energy production issues" -> "considered a mitochondrial disease" -> 95%
CHAIN: "α-thalassemia" -> "related to hemoglobin production" -> "not primarily a mitochondrial disorder" -> "not a mitochondrial disease" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Essential fructosuria" -> "involves fructose metabolism" -> "due to enzyme deficiency" -> "not related to mitochondrial function" -> "not a mitochondrial disease" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Cushing's syndrome" -> "caused by excess cortisol" -> "related to adrenal function" -> "not a mitochondrial disorder" -> "not a mitochondrial disease" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Sickle cell anemia" -> "involves abnormal hemoglobin" -> "genetic disorder affecting red blood cells" -> "not related to mitochondrial function" -> "not a mitochondrial disease" -> 90%
analysis: Leigh syndrome is a mitochondrial disease characterized by a progressive neurological disorder that typically arises due to defects in mitochondrial energy production. The other options listed are not classified as mitochondrial diseases.
